plan.summary: This 4-week block starts a 12-week off-camp boxing S&C cycle with one focused weekly session built around power first, then strength, then practical accessories. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lower-body lift so future loading can be anchored, and the main build work starts in Week 2. Because sparring is a priority and weekly S&C frequency is low, volume stays tight and high-value so you can recover and still push quality.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build a base of strength and general power with simple, well-coached movements that do not interfere with boxing work.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress force and power with slightly heavier work while keeping volume controlled around sparring and skill sessions.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift toward faster, sharper output while maintaining enough strength to support punching speed and resilience.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump as high as you can on every rep. Land softly and reset between reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low box and step down each rep.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Start from a still quarter squat and explode straight up.

exercises.name: 1b. Medicine Ball Chest Pass
exercises.notes: Throw hard with full intent. Use a non-bouncing or low-bouncing ball and reset cleanly each rep.

substitutionOptions.name: Medicine Ball Scoop Toss
substitutionOptions.notes: Drive from the legs and hips and throw forward with speed.

exercises.name: 2. Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Use smooth warm-up sets, then build to one hard set of 3-5 reps with solid depth and form. This session sets your baseline for future loading.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Stop before technique breaks and log the load and reps for future training.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if your available dumbbell is too light for a useful goblet squat top set.

substitutionOptions.name: Kettlebell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use the heaviest stable front-loaded option you have.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the heaviest clean top set of 3-5 reps.

exercises.name: 3. One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Pull toward the hip, pause briefly at the top, and keep the torso steady. Finish with 1-2 reps left in reserve.

substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if lower-back support helps you stay stricter.

substitutionOptions.name: Band-Resisted Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only if dumbbells are not available.

exercises.name: 4. Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.notes: Lower under control, pause lightly on the floor, then drive up hard. Finish with 1-2 reps left in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up

exercises.name: 5. Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Push the hips back, keep the dumbbells close, and feel the hamstrings load. Finish with 2 reps left in reserve.
